name: Pennsylvania
short: Pennsylvania has no statewide home rebate in 2026, so your utility matters. PECO pays $200 to $300 for a heat pump and $350 for a heat pump water heater. PPL Electric pays $225 to $500 for a heat pump and $400 for a heat pump water heater. We could not confirm the new amounts for Penelec and Duquesne Light. The state Sunshine solar rebate closed in 2013 and the federal solar credit ended after 2025.
